blocks.text: What happens to my data when I upgrade?

blocks.p: It comes with you. Your documents, order history, suppliers and setup move into your Everstock workspace. There is nothing to export or re-enter.

blocks.text: How does per-seat pricing work on Base?

blocks.p: Base is $199/mo plus $75 for each seat. Your bill is capped at $499/mo, so adding people past that point costs nothing extra.
